I'm an electrochemical engineer who develops new experimental techniques to reveal how clean energy devices work, and why they fail.

- **Techniques:** custom experimental cells and measurements, from precise electrical diagnostics to 3D X-ray imaging at national synchrotron facilities
- **Scope:** catalysts, membranes and full cells
- **Applications:** water electrolysis and CO~2~ conversion
- **Approach:** cross-disciplinary work between academia and industry, turning careful experiments into insights that help engineers build better technology
